notes: Product-scoped candidate for Bitunix Easy Earn. The reviewed agreement was published 2025-08-14 and updated 2026-05-28 but does not establish the original umbrella-product launch date, so canonical launch_date should remain null. It defines Flexible Savings and Fixed-Term Savings, transfers subscribed assets from Spot Account to Earn Account, and allocates 15% of interest distribution to a risk reserve while distributing 85% to the user. The agreement says returns vary with market conditions and Bitunix is not liable for fund losses caused by force majeure, system failure, hacking or policy changes. Those risk-reserve and repayment mechanics must not be converted into a universal principal, custody or solvency guarantee.
